name: population-growth
title: Population growth (annual %) by country and region, 1960–2025
description: World Bank World Development Indicators series SP.POP.GROW: the exponential rate of growth of midyear population from year t-1 to t, as a percentage, for 217 economies and 48 World Bank aggregates (regions, income groups, World), 1960–2025. Aggregates are flagged with is_aggregate — do not sum them with countries. An empty population_growth_pct means the World Bank publishes no estimate for that entity and year. Snapshot of the World Bank Indicators API taken 2026-09-18 (WDI last updated 2026-07-13); rebuilt offline by build.ts from the archived JSON responses.

fields.name: is_aggregate
